# Security & Data Protection Requirements Checklist: Jisr MCP Server

**Purpose**: Validate that the security and data-protection *requirements* are complete, quantified, and internally consistent — before implementation begins
**Created**: 2026-08-29
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Requirement Completeness

- [ ] CHK001 Are requirements defined for where audit events are written, given this release has no database? [Gap, Spec §FR-038]
- [ ] CHK002 Is a retention requirement specified for audit events and logs, the only data this release produces? [Gap, Spec §FR-038]
- [ ] CHK003 Are requirements defined for how the caller's own employee identity is established under the employee-self profile? [Gap, Spec §FR-019]
- [ ] CHK004 Are requirements specified for how Jisr credentials are supplied and protected at rest in a self-hosted deployment? [Gap, Spec §FR-025]
- [ ] CHK005 Are requirements defined for credential rotation and for revoking a compromised Jisr key? [Gap]
- [ ] CHK006 Does the spec require that a data-classification register exist as a maintained artifact, or only that classification happen? [Completeness, Spec §FR-024]
- [ ] CHK007 Are requirements defined for what happens when a field arrives with no assigned classification? [Gap, Spec §FR-024]
- [ ] CHK008 Are requirements specified for resisting prompt-injection content carried inside employee records, beyond noting it as an edge case? [Gap, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK009 Are rate-limiting or abuse-control requirements defined for the server's own surface, as distinct from upstream limits? [Gap]
- [ ] CHK010 Are requirements defined for the finance opt-in's granularity — whole surface, or per financial tool? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-023a]

## Requirement Clarity

- [ ] CHK011 Is "narrowest data that answers the request" expressed in a way that can be objectively evaluated? [Measurability, Spec §FR-028]
- [ ] CHK012 Is the cursor expiry period quantified, rather than described only as "an expiry"? [Clarity, Spec §FR-033]
- [ ] CHK013 Is "documented product purpose and legal basis" for sensitive-identity fields defined — where it lives and who approves it? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-024]
- [ ] CHK014 Is the manager profile's reachable set defined as direct reports only or the full reporting tree? [Gap, Spec §FR-019]
- [ ] CHK015 Is "undiscoverable" given a testable definition covering both the tool list and refusal messages? [Clarity, Spec §FR-018]
- [ ] CHK016 Are the per-invocation total-record ceilings quantified, or only required to exist? [Clarity, Spec §FR-034]
- [ ] CHK017 Is "tamper-evident" defined for audit records, or used without a stated property? [Ambiguity, Plan §Constitution Check]
- [ ] CHK018 Is the boundary between `EMPLOYEE_PERSONAL` and `EMPLOYEE_SENSITIVE` stated as a rule, or only demonstrated by examples? [Clarity, data-model §1]

## Requirement Consistency

- [ ] CHK019 Do FR-026 (financial data must not appear in general HR results) and the documented upstream behaviour that the employee list returns salary fields resolve without contradiction in the requirements text? [Conflict, Spec §FR-026, research R2]
- [ ] CHK020 Are the seven role profiles used consistently across spec, data model, and endpoint manifest, with no profile named in one and absent from another? [Consistency, Spec §FR-019]
- [ ] CHK021 Do the classification rules in the spec and the field table in the data model agree on every field they both mention? [Consistency, data-model §3]
- [ ] CHK022 Is the requirement that organization context be explicit consistent with a release that serves exactly one organization — is the reason for the redundancy stated? [Consistency, Spec §FR-022]
- [ ] CHK023 Are the audit requirements consistent between the spec and the constitution's stronger logging obligation for financial access? [Consistency, Spec §FR-038]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [ ] CHK024 Can SC-003 ("zero occurrences of credential values") be evaluated exhaustively, and is the set of artifacts it covers enumerated? [Measurability, Spec §SC-003]
- [ ] CHK025 Is SC-004's authorization matrix bounded — is the exact set of profiles and tools it must cover stated? [Measurability, Spec §SC-004]
- [ ] CHK026 Does SC-013 specify how "financial tools absent from the listed surface" is observed, given the list is filtered per caller? [Clarity, Spec §SC-013]
- [ ] CHK027 Are success criteria defined for the enumeration-resistance property, or is it only stated as an acceptance scenario? [Gap, Spec §User Story 3]

## Scenario & Edge Case Coverage

- [ ] CHK028 Are requirements defined for the failure mode of the redaction mechanism itself — does it fail closed? [Gap, Spec §FR-029]
- [ ] CHK029 Are requirements specified for the case where the HR credential and the finance credential resolve to different organizations? [Gap, Edge Case]
- [ ] CHK030 Are requirements defined for concurrent invocations that would collectively exceed a per-invocation record ceiling? [Coverage, Gap]
- [ ] CHK031 Are requirements specified for what an error may contain when the upstream failure body itself carries personal data? [Gap, Spec §FR-035]
- [ ] CHK032 Are requirements defined for behaviour when the connected key's permissions change mid-session? [Coverage, Gap]
- [ ] CHK033 Are recovery requirements defined for a detected credential compromise, or is that out of scope by intent? [Gap, Exception Flow]

## Dependencies & Assumptions

- [ ] CHK034 Is the assumption that the operator controls the machine running a stdio server stated and its security consequences drawn out? [Assumption, Gap]
- [ ] CHK035 Is the assumption validated that Jisr key permissions are the true outer boundary, given upstream permission-to-endpoint mapping is undocumented? [Assumption, Plan §Open Dependencies]
- [ ] CHK036 Are the security consequences of the deferred hosted deployment recorded, so the seams are not weakened later by convenience? [Traceability, Spec §FR-002]

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied
- Leave items unchecked when they still require clarification, correction, or reviewer evaluation
- `/speckit-implement` reads checklist checkbox state as a gate and must not modify markers
- `checklists/requirements.md` has a separate built-in lifecycle maintained by `/speckit-specify` and `/speckit-clarify`
- CHK001, CHK002 and CHK019 are the highest-value items here: the first two describe a real hole created by the live-only decision, the third is the gap Phase 0 found by accident
